_doc: Necropathy locked pixel-art palette (GDD 15.0 'Art pass (true pixel art)'; docs/art/ART_BIBLE.md 'Palette').
Single source of truth for tools/prepare_sprite.py (grid mode snaps every pixel to these colours),
tools/art_check.py (flags off-palette pixels) and the art bible's colour table.
colors: name, hex (sRGB), ramp (primary ramp), index (position in that ramp, 0 = darkest),
group (ink = outline darks, unit = body colours, glow = emissive highlights, floor = ground only),
role (what it is for). Floor colours are never used by sprites (prepare_sprite.py never snaps to them).
ramps: ordered dark -> light lists of colour names. members[0] is the ramp's outline ink (the darkest
shade of that hue). A ramp may borrow a colour whose primary ramp is another one (the ice ramp's shade
is the cold grey, the gold ramp's shade is the light brown), which keeps the palette small.
Outline of a pixel = members[0] of its colour's primary ramp; rim light = the next member after it.
Lightness targets (OKLab L, 0-1): inks 0.17-0.21 (just below the floors), floors 0.21-0.30,

arcane.role: deep arcane / frost blue: Undead Mage, Lich, Crypt Warder ward

gold.role: Covenant gold (elites, Sanctum kinds, bosses), halos, holy white glow

bronze.role: the Olympian Republic's bronze (Act IV): helmets, cuirasses, round shields, the Titans; warmer and duller than the Covenant gold, which stays gold (evolution, chest, victory, Glory)

lacquer.role: the Shogunate's red lacquer (Act V): armour, the oni's red skin, banners; harder and warmer than the Covenant crimson (never the player's violet)

sakura.role: the Shogunate's sakura pink (Act V): blossom petals, the kitsune's trim, shrine paper (outline borrowed from the lacquer ink)

obsidian.role: the Inferno's black obsidian (Act VI): hell knight armour, chains, the demon portal's ring; the light shade is the rim that keeps black armour readable on a dark floor

lava.role: the Inferno's lava (Act VI): ember cracks, burning blades, pit fire and eyes (outline borrowed from the obsidian ink)

demon.role: the Inferno's demon skin (Act VI): imps, brutes, the succubus; a magenta-red apart from the Covenant crimson and the Shogunate lacquer (outline borrowed from the obsidian ink)

charm.role: the Inferno's charm pink (Act VI): Temptation, the portal's swirl, hearts; the act's signature colour (outline borrowed from the obsidian ink)

blood.role: the Sanguine Court's blood red (Act VII): blood knight plate, drain beams, vampire eyes; darker and bluer than the Covenant crimson (never the player's violet)

velvet.role: the Sanguine Court's black-purple velvet (Act VII): capes, gowns, hair, hangings; the light shade is the rim that keeps black cloth readable (outline borrowed from the blood ink)

moonlight.role: the Sanguine Court's moonlit silver (Act VII): werewolf fur, bat membranes, silver weapons, mist (outline borrowed from the blood ink)

asphalt.role: the Last Line's asphalt (Act VIII): riot and SWAT armour, dark clothes, tyres, the street; the act's ink is city_ink #101114

concrete.role: the Last Line's concrete (Act VIII): roofs, kerbs, gun metal, clear shields (outline borrowed from the city ink)

olive.role: the Last Line's army olive (Act VIII): soldiers, tanks, the medic's green (outline borrowed from the city ink)

hazard.role: hazard yellow (Act VIII): road paint, crosswalks, hazard stripes, tracers (its own ramp so a flat yellow never shades an olive)

neon_sodium.role: sodium orange glow (Act VIII): streetlight pools, muzzle flashes, bat wood, headlights

neon_pink.role: neon pink glow (Act VIII): shop signs, bandanas and clothes accents

neon_cyan.role: neon cyan glow (Act VIII): shop signs, visors, goggles, the medic's cross glow

police.role: police blue (Act VIII): riot cop fatigues, the patrol car, the blue lamp; city_police_blue is the fixed colour, the dark and light shades are added

siren_red.role: siren red (Act VIII): the red lamp, warning marks, blood on the street

hero.role: hero orange (Act VIII): Blitz's suit and speed rings; city_hero_orange is the fixed colour, the dark and light shades are added

neon.role: GROUP (documentation only, never a faction ramp): the Last Line's night glow as the brief names it; the sodium, pink and cyan each shade in their own ramp above

siren.role: GROUP (documentation only, never a faction ramp): the emergency lights and hero colour as the brief names them; each hue shades in its own ramp above (police, siren_red, hero), because one ramp stretching lightness across three hues turns blue into red

hull.role: the Concord's hull white (Act IX): the saucer, the greys' skin and jumpsuits, the Prism's gown; the act's ink is concord_ink #07080F

gunmetal.role: the Concord's gunmetal (Act IX): Vrask armour, saucer rim, probes, staffs

plasma.role: the Concord's plasma green (Act IX): lamps, eyes, tractor beams, vents (the Brood's acid green too)

laser.role: the Concord's laser magenta (Act IX): aiming lines, beams, the Prism's trim; concord_laser is the fixed colour, the dark shade is added

chitin.role: the Brood's green-black chitin (Act IX): broodlings, the Brood's beasts

hive.role: the Hive Mother's purple (Act IX): HER chitin only, through KEY_RAMPS, never in the faction set (it sits near the player's violet)

hive_bone.role: the Hive Mother's cream spines and claws (Act IX): her own ramp (KEY_RAMPS) so a flat cream never shades a purple

vrask.role: the Vrask's teal scales (Act IX); concord_vrask is the fixed colour, the dark and light shades are added

lumen.role: the Luminous's pale white-gold light (Act IX): the Sentinel, the Prism's hair; never the UI gold

lavender.role: the Star-Seer's lavender skin (Act IX): the Prism's face and hands only (its own ramp so it never pulls on the hull white or the player's violet)

turf.role: the Concord's alien flesh ground (Act IX): the Terraformer's roots and the tiles/concord_turf patches (veins in plasma green)

frost.role: the Hall of the Slain's frost white (Act VI)

hearth.role: hearth amber (Act VI): fires, the fire-giant; per key only (it sits near skin)

valk.role: valkyrie pale gold (Act VI): wings, spears, the Einherjar glow; never the UI gold

rune.role: ice-blue rune glow (Act VI), clear of the undead's soul-teal

norse_floor.role: GROUND colours of the Hall of the Slain (tiles only, never sprites): night snow, fjord ice, hall planks, hall slabs, Vigrid ash, each three shades dark -> light

floor.role: ground colours of the three stages (tiles only, never sprites), dark -> light; the zone tiles add close shades per zone
